decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the variation of condition 4 of planning permission 00628/B/P5 to allow an additional internal retail floor area of 367 square metres would not have a significant adverse upon the servicing and parking of the existing development or the viability of The Hounslow Town Centre.  The development is in accordance with Policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), S.3.1 (New Retail Development) and T.1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing for Developments) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
(Reason.  To accord with the provisions of Section 92(1) of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990)

Condition : 3 - The floor area of the approved mezzanine floor shall have a maximum area of 367 square metres and only be used for retail purposes ancillary to the main authorised retail use of the premises.

REASON: To ensure that the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
description: Installation of a 367 square metre internal mezzanine floor (application required by the terms of condition 4 of planning permission ref 00628/B/P5 (Appeal ref APP/F 5540/A/94/235228/P7)).
